Presentation · 12 min

The Midnight Interview

Listen to James, a creator of invented languages. First listen for the big idea, then listen again for details.

Neo Radio · Track 3.06

Why do people invent languages?

Host: Welcome to Neo Radio. James, why do people invent languages like Elvish?
James: Some invented languages are similar to English, but they are new. They can help people communicate in stories and imaginary worlds.
Host: Who do you speak Elvish with?
James: I speak it with readers of The Lord of the Rings at conferences. Before I was sixteen, I spoke five languages. Later, I am going to learn Turkish and tell radio listeners more about my work.

Practice · 15 min

Say or Tell?

Use say for words and messages. Use tell when we include the listener or use certain fixed collocations.

SAYsay + somethingsay something to someone

say hello · say sorry · say yes/no · say something in Italian

TELLtell + someone + somethingtell + fixed phrase

tell someone a secret · tell a story · tell a joke · tell the truth · tell a lie
